caption:
A whole football stadium inside a car tire.
Seedance 2.0 shrank a final onto a table.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 10 seconds, 3:4 vertical portrait. Look: hyper-realistic miniature macro photography, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, tiny diorama detail, rich textures (rubber, wood grain, grass blades), warm golden late-afternoon sunlight low from the back-left casting long dramatic shadows, natural warm color grade. Camera feel: ONE continuous unbroken drone-like move with no cuts: a slow orbit, then an accelerating dive into the stadium, ending in a low macro tracking shot on the grass. Pacing: calm and slow for 3 seconds, a fast swooping dive for 3 seconds, then slow-motion action for the last 4 seconds. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos, no readable lettering anywhere.

CHARACTERS:
- PLAYER A (the dribbler, left): a lean young footballer, light-brown skin, shaved head, clean-shaven, sharp cheekbones. Kit: emerald-green shirt with thin white vertical pinstripes and a large white number 4 on the back, white shorts, emerald socks, white boots. Signature: the green pinstriped shirt and shaved head.
- PLAYER B (the defender, right): a stocky footballer, pale freckled skin, curly copper-red hair tied in a small top bun, short red beard. Kit: black shirt with bright gold sleeves and a gold number 9, black shorts, gold socks, black boots. Signature: the copper top bun and gold sleeves.
- THE CROWD: thousands of tiny fans, one half in emerald green and white, the other half in black and gold, waving small green-white and black-gold flags.

LOCATION: a real black car tire lying flat on a rustic weathered wooden plank table (warm brown planks, visible grain and a dark knot). Built inside the tire's ring is a complete miniature football stadium: steep tiered stands packed with fans, a bright striped green pitch with white lines and two white goals in the centre. Two huge cloth banners are draped over the upper stands: a green-and-white banner at the top-left and a black-and-gold banner at the top-right. Outside the tire on the wood: a small blue-and-white entrance gate with a ticket booth, tiny fans queuing and walking around it, and a small white minivan. Seen from inside at pitch level, the stands rise in tiers and the black rubber tire tread forms the curved upper wall of the stadium, with a circle of bright blue sky above.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:10.1) — One continuous take, no cuts:
- 00:00.0-00:02.8 — The tire stadium. High-angle three-quarter top-down view of the whole tire on the wooden table: MUST SHOW: the full miniature stadium inside the tire ring with the green pitch in the centre, the two big banners on the upper stands, the entrance gate, tiny fans and the white minivan on the wood in the lower part of the frame. The camera slowly orbits clockwise around the tire and gently pushes in and down; tiny players move on the pitch, the crowd ripples and waves flags.
- 00:02.8-00:04.3 — The dive. The camera accelerates over the rim of the tire and plunges down into the stadium, rotating slightly, with fast motion blur on the stands; the black tire sidewall rushes past the bottom of the frame and the green-and-white banner sweeps past on one side; the pitch tilts and grows as the camera drops, two players visible near the centre circle.
- 00:04.3-00:05.5 — The descent. The camera swoops low over the stands behind one goal and glides forward just above the grass toward the centre circle, the white goal passing below; the two players grow from tiny to clear, one dribbling a ball toward the other.
- 00:05.5-00:10.1 — The duel. Camera lands at grass height: a low-angle macro side view, sharp grass blades blurred in the foreground, the two players in the centre of the frame facing each other in slow motion. Player A (left) dribbles the ball with his right foot, arms out for balance, body leaning in; Player B (right) lunges in with his left foot to tackle, arms spread; the ball stays between their boots as they jostle; small grass flecks kick up. Long sunlit shadows of both players stretch across the grass toward the camera. Behind them the packed tiered stands curve around with green-white and black-gold flags waving, the black tire tread rises as the upper wall, blue sky above. The camera tracks slowly sideways and pushes in slightly.

SOUND: no music. A huge crowd roar that echoes slightly as if inside the rubber ring, rhythmic drums, scattered whistles, flags flapping; during the dive a rushing whoosh of air; in the final duel the crowd cheering swells, with crisp close-up sounds of boots on grass and the soft thud of the ball being touched.
prompt_short: Hyper-real miniature macro, 3:4: a packed football stadium built inside a car tire on a wooden table. One continuous camera move orbits, dives into the stands and lands at grass level on two players dueling for the ball in slow motion. Golden light, roaring crowd.
